categories.name: Diagrams as code
categories.description: Author diagrams in text or a programming language, then render them for documentation or review.

entries.name: ARC
entries.description: Typed TypeScript and JSON architecture diagrams with a React renderer, visual editor, and CLI; a companion viewer provides lossy Mermaid flowchart and state-diagram import.

entries.name: Archify
entries.description: Agent skill that turns descriptions or repository analysis into typed JSON source and self-contained interactive HTML diagrams.

entries.name: C4-PlantUML
entries.description: PlantUML macros for authoring C4 diagrams; requires PlantUML rather than providing a standalone modeling application.

entries.name: D2
entries.description: Declarative diagram language with nested containers, multiple layout engines, and a local CLI.

entries.name: Diagrams
entries.description: Python library for cloud and on-premises architecture diagrams using provider node types and Graphviz rendering.

entries.name: Graphviz
entries.description: Graph visualization tools that lay out and render DOT descriptions of nodes, edges, and clusters.

entries.name: Mermaid
entries.description: Text-based diagramming library for flowcharts, sequence diagrams, and other diagram types embedded in documentation.

entries.name: PasteZap Flowchart Maker
entries.description: Browser-based Mermaid flowchart authoring with an add-step form, editable source, and SVG/PNG export for documenting system relationships.

entries.name: PlantUML
entries.description: Text-based UML and related diagrams, including component, deployment, and sequence diagrams.

categories.name: Architecture models and views
categories.description: Describe architecture concepts and relationships, or use a defined notation to communicate them across diagrams.

entries.name: Archi
entries.description: Desktop modeling application for ArchiMate enterprise architecture models and views.

entries.name: IcePanel
entries.description: Visual C4 modeling tool that reuses model objects across connected architecture diagrams.

entries.name: Ilograph
entries.description: Model-based, interactive system diagrams with automatic layouts and zoomable views of components and flows.

entries.name: LikeC4
entries.description: Architecture DSL that generates interactive views from a shared model and supports embedding diagrams in applications and documentation.

entries.name: Structurizr
entries.description: C4 models as code using Structurizr DSL to create multiple architecture views from one model.

categories.name: Visual editors
categories.description: Draw and arrange diagrams directly. General-purpose editors are included when they support software architecture sketching or documentation.

entries.name: draw.io
entries.description: Visual diagram editor, also available at app.diagrams.net, with UML, network, and infrastructure shape libraries.

entries.name: Eraser
entries.description: Technical diagramming workspace with a visual canvas, diagram-as-code authoring, and AI-assisted diagram generation.

entries.name: Excalidraw
entries.description: Open-source whiteboard with a hand-drawn style for sketching systems and collaborating on early designs.

categories.name: Rendering services
categories.description: Convert existing diagram source into images through an API; the source language still defines the diagram.

entries.name: Kroki
entries.description: Unified HTTP rendering API for languages and tools including Graphviz, Mermaid, PlantUML, and D2.

categories.name: Diagram UI and layout libraries
categories.description: Building blocks for custom editors and viewers. These require application development.

entries.name: ELK.js
entries.description: JavaScript graph layout algorithms that compute element positions and edge routes. Rendering and interaction are supplied by the consuming application.

entries.name: React Flow
entries.description: React components for interactive node-and-edge editors and viewers, with customizable nodes and edges; applications supply layout separately.

categories.name: Learning resources
categories.description: Methods and notation for communicating software architecture across levels of detail.

entries.name: C4 model
entries.description: A framework for describing software architecture through system context, container, component, and code diagrams.
